response.sql: WITH proj AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), withavg AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS fund_avg FROM proj) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - fund_avg AS excess FROM withavg ORDER BY (ratio - fund_avg) IS NULL, excess DESC LIMIT 10
